name: Process Message Handles LLM Client Exception
description: Verifies that process_message returns a fallback error message when the LLM client raises an exception.
input: A user message and a mocked LLM client that raises an exception.
output: A fallback error message string is returned.
success_criteria: Returned response contains 'I apologize, but I encountered an error'
error_scenarios: Returned response does not indicate an error
